lines: 读到第五十个词时，第一个词还留在模型脑子里吗？
When the model reaches word fifty, is word one still there?
答案不在记性好不好，而在信息怎么沿时间传。
The answer is not about memory quality, but how signal travels through time.
第 3 章给了词向量，但词向量本身没有顺序，也没有记忆。
Chapter three gave words vectors, but vectors have no order and no memory.
这一章讲三件事：怎么记、记不住怎么办、怎么回看。
This chapter covers remembering, failing to remember, and looking back.
从循环网络出发，一路走到注意力的门口。
We start from recurrent networks and end at the door of attention.
它是 Transformer 之前，必须跨过的一道坎。
It is the step you must cross before the Transformer.
最直接的想法：把整句的词向量拼起来，喂给全连接网络。
The obvious idea: concatenate every word vector and feed a dense network.
但句子长度不固定，三个词和三百个词，输入维度就不同。
But sentence length varies, so the input dimension varies too.
参数量还会随长度爆炸，模型根本撑不住。
The parameter count explodes with length; the model cannot hold it.
更麻烦的是，它学不到位置五和位置六是相邻的。
Worse, it cannot learn that position five sits next to position six.
我们需要一个带状态的函数：每读一个词，更新一次状态。
We need a function with state: read one word, update the state.
状态里装着的，是到目前为止读到了什么。
The state holds what has been read so far.
循环网络的做法是：每读一步，就更新一次隐藏状态。
A recurrent network updates its hidden state at every step.
新的状态，由旧状态和当前这个词共同决定。
The new state depends on the old state and the current word.
把它写成一行：新状态等于旧状态和当前词，再经过一个压缩函数。
In one line: old state plus current word, pushed through a squash function.
关键是这两组权重，所有时间步共享同一份。
The key is that both weight matrices are shared across all steps.
共享带来两个好处：能处理任意长度，参数量还不涨。
Sharing buys two things: any length, and no growth in parameters.
代价是同一条路要反复走，信息只能一步一步往前传。
The price: the same path is walked again and again, one step at a time.
这句话很轻，但它埋下了后面所有麻烦的种子。
That sentence is light, but it plants every problem that follows.
把循环按时间展开，就是一张很深的计算图。
Unrolled over time, the loop becomes a very deep graph.
一层就是一个时间步，层数等于句子长度。
One layer per time step, so the depth equals the sentence length.
假设一句话有五十个词，它就是五十层的网络。
Fifty words means a fifty-layer network.
训练时，误差要从最后一步，一路传回第一步。
Training sends the error from the last step all the way back to the first.
每经过一个时间步，都要再乘一次权重和导数。
Each step multiplies by a weight matrix and by the tanh derivative.
这条路很长，后面所有的麻烦都出在路上。
That path is long, and every problem lives on it.
每传一步都要乘一个因子，这是两个失败模式的根源。
Every step multiplies by a factor; that is the root of both failures.
因子长期小于一，梯度就指数级衰减，这叫梯度消失。
Factors below one shrink the gradient exponentially: vanishing.
因子长期大于一，梯度就指数级放大，这叫梯度爆炸。
Factors above one blow it up exponentially: exploding.
爆炸好办：梯度超过阈值，就按比例缩回去，叫梯度裁剪。
Exploding is easy: clip the gradient back when it passes a threshold.
消失难办，因为它不是数值问题，是信息在结构上存不住。
Vanishing is hard: the information has nowhere structural to stay.
所以别把它说成记性差，那是结果，不是原因。
So it is not bad memory; bad memory is the symptom, not the cause.
就算每步只丢一成，五十步后也只剩百分之零点五。
Even losing just ten percent a step leaves half a percent after fifty.
一九九七年，Hochreiter 等人提出了 LSTM。
In 1997, Hochreiter and Schmidhuber proposed the LSTM.
它的核心创新，是在隐藏状态之外，再加一条细胞状态。
Its key move: a cell state running beside the hidden state.
所有信息通过门，有控制地进出，而不是每步全部重写。
Information enters and leaves through gates, instead of being rewritten.
看更新式：细胞状态等于遗忘门乘旧状态，加上输入门乘新内容。
Read the update: old cell times the forget gate, plus new content times the input gate.
如果遗忘门接近一，细胞状态几乎原样保留。
When the forget gate sits near one, the cell state passes through almost unchanged.
梯度沿着这条加法路径往回走，几乎不衰减。
The gradient travels that additive path with almost no decay.
原文把这叫常数误差传送带，一条记忆的高速路。
The paper calls it the constant error carousel: a highway for memory.
每个门就是一个 sigmoid，把值压到零到一之间。
Each gate is a sigmoid that squeezes values between zero and one.
零就是关，一就是开，中间是半开，正好当开关用。
Zero is closed, one is open, and everything between is a dimmer.
遗忘门决定旧记忆保留多少，输入门决定新信息写入多少。
The forget gate keeps old memory; the input gate writes new information.
候选记忆是这一步想写的内容，两者相加，更新细胞状态。
A candidate holds what to write, and the two are added into the cell state.
输出门决定这一步暴露多少，给下一个时间步看。
The output gate decides how much to expose to the next step.
GRU 是简化版：门更少，参数更少，结构更轻。
The GRU is a simplified version: fewer gates, fewer parameters, lighter.
二零一四年，Sutskever 等人把理解和生成拆成两半。
In 2014, Sutskever and colleagues split understanding from generation.
编码器读完整句中文，只留下最后一个状态。
The encoder reads the whole sentence and keeps one final state.
解码器从这个状态出发，一个词一个词吐出英文。
The decoder starts from that state and emits English word by word.
训练时用教师强制：喂正确的上一个词，而不是模型自己猜的。
Training uses teacher forcing: feed the correct previous word, not the guess.
问题在于：整句信息被压进一个固定长度的向量。
The problem: the entire sentence is squeezed into one fixed-length vector.
句子一长，这个向量就是瓶颈，像把一本书塞进一个信封。
On a long sentence that vector is a bottleneck, like a book in an envelope.
句子越长，塞不进这个信封的东西就越多。
The longer the sentence, the more falls outside the envelope.
二零一四年，Bahdanau 等人换了个思路：不压缩，按需回看。
In 2014, Bahdanau and colleagues stopped compressing and started looking back.
翻译知识就是力量时，输出 power 那一刻，只需要看力量。
To output power, the decoder only needs to look at the source word for power.
解码器每一步，都拿当前状态去和编码器每个位置打分。
At every step it scores the current state against every encoder position.
分数过一遍 softmax 变成权重，再加权求和，得到上下文向量。
Scores become weights through softmax; a weighted sum gives the context vector.
这个向量和当前状态一起，决定下一个输出词。
That vector, with the current state, decides the next output word.
没人告诉它 power 该对齐力量，对齐是训练自己长出来的。
Nobody told it that power aligns with the word for power; it emerged.
但别过度解读：权重高，只说明分数高，不等于真的依赖。
Do not overread it: a high weight is a high score, not proof of reliance.
把这件事抽象出来，只需要三个角色：查询、键、值。
Abstract the operation and only three roles remain: query, key, value.
查询是解码器当前状态，键和值都是编码器的各个位置。
The query is the decoder state; keys and values are encoder positions.
查询和每个键算一个匹配分数，分数越高，越值得看。
The query is scored against every key; a higher score deserves a look.
分数归一化成权重，再对所有值加权求和。
Scores become weights, and the weights average all the values.
所以注意力就是：用相似度当权重，对值做加权平均。
So attention is similarity used as weight, averaging the values.
这套写法，后来就叫 Query、Key、Value。
That is the Query, Key, Value form you will meet everywhere.
剥掉术语，注意力就是一个软版本的字典查询。
Strip the jargon and attention is a soft dictionary lookup.
数据库用键精确查找，命中就返回唯一一条记录。
A database matches a key exactly and returns one record.
注意力用查询和所有键算相似度，返回所有值的加权平均。
Attention scores the query against every key and averages every value.
硬匹配是零或一，软匹配是零到一之间的连续权重。
Hard matching is zero or one; soft matching is a weight in between.
关键在于可导：只选第三个，这个操作没有梯度。
The point is differentiability: picking the third item has no gradient.
但它是加权平均，不是检索到事实，别把权重当成真相。
But it is an average, not a fact lookup; weights are not truth.
LSTM 统治序列建模近二十年，到二零一七年仍是翻译主流。
The LSTM ruled sequence modelling for nearly twenty years.
但它有三个结构性局限：串行、瓶颈、仍然会衰减。
It carries three structural limits: serial, bottlenecked, still fading.
隐藏状态必须等上一步算完，GPU 几千个核只能干等。
The hidden state must wait, so thousands of GPU cores sit idle.
注意力本身不用等：所有位置可以同时打分。
Attention does not wait: every position scores every position at once.
循环网络不能，它必须一步一步往下传。
Recurrence cannot: it must pass the state on, step by step.
二零一七年，有人问：既然注意力这么好用，还要 RNN 吗？
In 2017 someone asked: if attention works, why keep the RNN?
这一章的主线，是记忆从循环走向回看。
The through-line is memory moving from recurrence to looking back.
循环把历史压进一个状态，注意力按需去取。
The loop packs history into a state; attention fetches on demand.
瓶颈被拆掉了：不用再把整句压成一个向量。
The bottleneck is gone: no more squeezing the sentence into one vector.
但注意力还挂在循环上，还得一步一步解码。
But attention still rides on a loop, still decoding one step at a time.
下一章，Transformer 把循环也去掉。
Next chapter: the Transformer drops the loop entirely.
